title: Anaerobic Antibiotic Usage for Pneumonia in the Medical Intensive Care Unit
brief_summary: Observation of prescription usage of anaerobic antibiotics for patients admitted to the ICU with pneumonia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ICU patients with diagnosis of pneumonia

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with abdominal infections such as c diff.
study_population: Patients admitted to the intensive care unit with a diagnosis of pneumonia.
